newsitem.title: USA: Atlas Air jumps on optmistic Q4 outlook.
newsitem.headline: Atlas Air jumps on optmistic Q4 outlook.

text.p: Atlas Air Inc's stock jumped about 10 percent on Monday after the carrier said it expects operations to return to normal in the fourth quarter, following a one-time charge that dampened third quarter results.
"The stock's up because the bad news is out now and they can move on to the fourth quarter now," said David Campbell, an analyst with Scott & Stringfellow in Richmond.
"The company's optimistic that the fourth quarter will be back on track. Everything looks fine to me for that to happen," Campbell said.
The carrier's stock stock jumped 3-1/2 to 32-3/4 in heavy afternoon trading.
During the third quarter, Atlas earned $8.2 million, or $0.37 a share, including a $0.12 per share aircraft charge, compared with earnings of $5.6 million, or $0.32 a share, last year.
Atlas, which provides both freighter aircraft and crews to major airlines on long-term contracts, also confirmed that a key British Airways Plc contact had been renewed.
Atlas declined to comment on the value of the pact.
